c1_c5_semantic_audit_and_precedence_prot.three_field_c1_invariant: For all 330 core primary studies, set(C1_all_applicable) == {C1_evidence_state} union set(C1_secondary_regimes) and C1_evidence_state not in set(C1_secondary_regimes) (0 omissions out of 336 rows; 6 core foundational/survey rows including BEIR venueExpanded087 marked N/A_foundational_or_survey).
c1_c5_semantic_audit_and_precedence_prot.primary_vs_secondary_adjudication_rule: Step 1 (Strand-Anchored Primary): C1_evidence_state records the primary perturbation regime targeted by the study core thesis and mechanism strand (Strand 3.x -> adversarially_manipulated; Strand 2.2-2.4 -> conflicting_evidence; Strand 1.1-1.4 & 2.1 -> noisy_or_distracting; Strand 4.1-4.5 -> insufficient_or_uncertain; general cross-pipeline evaluation suites -> clean_or_heterogeneous_mix), while C1_secondary_regimes records auxiliary evaluation splits. Step 2 (Multi-Stressor Benchmark Tie-Breaking): Benchmarks spanning multiple stressors without a single method locus are adjudicated by severity precedence (adversarially_manipulated > conflicting_evidence > noisy_or_distracting > insufficient_or_uncertain > clean_or_heterogeneous_mix).

representative_selection_rules.Rule_R1_same_strand_and_c1_c5_cell: Excludes incremental variants occupying the same (Pillar, Strand, C1-C5) cell as an included canonical anchor (69 Stage-1a + 2 Round-2 code-RAG variants rrag194 ImportSnare & rrag196 VenomRACG).
representative_selection_rules.Rule_R2_mandatory_retention_of_counterex: Mandatorily retains any study reporting negative results, failure boundaries, or empirical counterexamples (0 counterexamples excluded across all 71 secondary variants).
representative_selection_rules.Rule_R3_denominator_eligibility: Restricts C1-C5 percentages to descriptive sample composition of the audited corpus (never population prevalence); mechanistic conclusions rely on within-study paired controls and formal propositions.
